field_origins.payload-index.cut_utc: Exact original fixed seed and Root authority, full bytes/SHA256/Git validated.
field_origins.payload-index.package_tree: All 157 normalized package children recomputed, then complete recursive Git tree readback.
field_origins.payload-index.counts: Independently recalculated from all collected walks, unique fullread original pins, canonical cut grants and normalized rows; exact phase totals asserted.
field_origins.payload-index.files:unchanged-original-a: Exact retained original tree leaf path/mode/SHA1/size joined to full UTF-8 body SHA256 qualification; each original blob body was read fully before normalization.
field_origins.payload-index.files:derived-*: The two A.metadata(walk) schema3 strings regenerated exactly, compared with full readback metadata pins; explicit seven row fields checked.
field_origins.cut-scope.packages: Exact seed new-root names/SHA/aliases joined to each verified normalized tree and its collected cuts; no alias creates an extra mount.
field_origins.cut-scope.canonical_inherited_roots: Seed array preserved by value and independently matched to the full CP23 original cut_scope canonical rows plus its 239 original packages.
field_origins.cut-scope.normalization_rule: Verbatim string value from the original CP23 cut_scope.
field_origins.cut-scope.fixed_seed/root_authority/prev: The original fixed authority pins; parent master body is not claimed to be read here.
field_origins.cut-scope.root_seed_privacy/root_seed_sc: Exact field values from the original Root seed, whose full raw bytes are retained; no new private source read or operational acceptance inferred.
field_origins.original-reconstruction-proof.packages: For every traversed original directory, original Merkle and every immediate child edge match one retained leaf, traversed directory, or exact authorized canonical cut. Omitted inherited subtrees remain canonical references.
field_origins.status: This collector adds no operational result, post-cut fact, or runtime/deployment qualification. Root owns final status and master append.

reproduction.invocation: Construct H from the pinned pure-git-verifier.js and A = assembly(H); call finalizeCp24(H,A,{seed_raw,authority_raw,parent_cut_raw},JSON.parse(collectionProgressRaw),JSON.parse(normalizationProgressRaw)). Compare all three returned files byte-for-byte and packages_tree with this receipt. Original archive bodies are never parsed/re-encoded by this finalizer.
reproduction.remote_readback: Fetch exact packages_tree with recursive=1; require untruncated and H.verifyGitTree(response, returned package_rows, packages_tree).
